title: Premium romantic single-page proposal website for Urvi Ji

requirements.summary: Establish a cohesive premium romantic theme (palette, glow/gradients, and consistent typography with serif headings + handwritten personal text).
acceptanceCriteria: All sections share a cohesive romantic premium style (palette, spacing, typography).
No blue/purple is used as a primary theme color.
Handwritten-style typography is used for the personal message section.

file_operations.description: Create global Tailwind/CSS theme tokens and base styles: blush pink/red/white with gold accents, soft glow/gradient utilities, consistent spacing, serif heading stack + handwritten-style stack for personal messages, and reduced-motion variants (prefers-reduced-motion).
Extend Tailwind theme with romantic palette aliases (blush/red/gold), gradient presets, and keyframes (soft-fade/float/heartbeat) to ensure consistent premium styling across sections.
Create a layout wrapper that applies the dreamy background, consistent typography classes, section spacing, and a readable content container for the single-page experience.

requirements.summary: Implement the Hero section with exact heading/subtext, heart-beat animation, and subtle entrance animation on load.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero displays the exact requested strings (including emoji).
Heart-beat animation loops smoothly without jank on mobile.
Hero content is centered and responsive across common phone sizes.

file_operations.description: Create the Hero section component with exact text: "Hey Urvi Ji ❤️" and "From the moment you came into my life, everything became more beautiful." Include a heart element with looping heartbeat animation and an on-load entrance animation (respecting reduced motion).
Create the single-page App composing all required sections and ensure Hero is rendered at the top with centered, responsive layout.

requirements.summary: Add floating hearts and falling rose petals ambient background effects, with performance safeguards and reduced/disabled motion support via toggle and OS preference.
acceptanceCriteria: Hearts and petals animate continuously without blocking scrolling.
Animations degrade gracefully (reduced density/disabled) when reduced motion is enabled or via an on-page toggle.
Effects do not obscure text readability (proper opacity and layering).

file_operations.description: Add generated asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/romantic-bg-pattern.dim_2048x2048.png and wire it as a subtle page background pattern (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).
Add generated asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/rose-petals-sprite.dim_512x512.png for petal particles (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).
Add generated asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/hearts-sprite.dim_512x512.png for heart particles (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).

Implement a performant ambient effects layer (canvas or lightweight DOM) that renders floating hearts + falling petals using the provided sprite sheets; ensure proper z-index/opacity so content stays readable; respect prefers-reduced-motion by disabling/reducing particle density.
Add an on-page toggle control to enable/disable or reduce ambient effects for the current session; persist choice in sessionStorage; ensure accessibility labels and high contrast.
Wire AmbientEffects and EffectsToggle into the single-page layout so effects apply across the page without blocking scrolling.

requirements.summary: Add gentle romantic instrumental background music with a visible toggle (play/pause + volume or mute), respecting autoplay policies and persisting session choice.
acceptanceCriteria: A visible music control is available and works on mobile and desktop.
Music does not unexpectedly autoplay with sound; playback begins only after user gesture or starts muted.
Toggling music updates immediately and does not reset on scroll within the session.

file_operations.description: Add a local romantic instrumental audio file at frontend/public/assets/music/romantic-instrumental.mp3 (no external streaming).
Create a small hook for session-scoped state persistence (e.g., music enabled, volume/muted, effects toggle).

Implement music controls using an <audio> element: start muted by default (or require explicit user interaction to play), provide play/pause and volume or mute controls, and persist settings in sessionStorage.
Place MusicControls in a fixed, unobtrusive position (e.g., top/right) within the single-page layout and ensure it remains usable on mobile.

requirements.summary: Create a Love Story timeline/card section with three requested beats and editable English placeholder copy, plus gentle scroll-in animations.
acceptanceCriteria: The Love Story section clearly contains three distinct items matching the requested topics.
Layout is responsive: vertical stacking on mobile; timeline/cards adapt cleanly to larger screens.
Each item has soft animation on scroll-in (non-intrusive).

file_operations.description: Implement a responsive timeline/card layout with three items titled: “How we met”, “Why she is special”, and “How she calls me ‘good boy’ and how that makes me feel loved”, each with well-written editable English placeholder copy.
Create a lightweight IntersectionObserver-based hook to apply subtle scroll-in animations (and disable/soften when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled).
Wire LoveStorySection into the single-page flow with an anchored section id for smooth scrolling navigation.

requirements.summary: Build a Photo Gallery section with an animated carousel using the two provided images and an Add Photos flow to add client-side images for the session only.
acceptanceCriteria: Carousel renders and transitions smoothly between the two provided images.
Gallery cards/images have rounded corners and subtle shadow consistent with the premium theme.
User can add additional images via file picker and see them appear in the slider for the current session.
No crash if the user adds a large image; slider remains usable (with sensible limits/error messaging).

file_operations.description: Add the provided image as a static asset at frontend/public/assets/gallery/Snapchat-869212999.jpg for initial gallery slides.
Add the provided image as a static asset at frontend/public/assets/gallery/Snapchat-261174748.jpg for initial gallery slides.

Implement a soft animated slider/carousel with cinematic transitions, rounded corners, and subtle shadows; initialize with the two provided images; include an “Add photos” UX using a file input to append images client-side for the session (no backend). Add size/type limits and user-friendly error messaging for large images.
Wire GallerySection into the single-page flow with an anchored section id and ensure it remains responsive and touch-friendly on mobile.

requirements.summary: Add a “Message From Me” section with exact handwritten-style text and subtle paper/ink styling with high readability and scroll-in animation.
acceptanceCriteria: The section displays the exact requested string (including punctuation).
Handwritten-style font is applied and remains readable on mobile.
Section has gentle scroll-in animation consistent with the rest of the page.

file_operations.description: Create the Message From Me section rendering the exact string: “I may not be perfect, but my love for you is pure and forever.” Apply handwritten-style font stack and subtle paper/ink styling while maintaining contrast and legibility; include gentle scroll-in animation via the shared reveal hook.
Wire MessageFromMeSection into the single-page flow with consistent spacing and anchored section id.

requirements.summary: Create the Proposal highlight section with exact glowing prompt, two animated buttons, celebratory heart-burst animation on click, and an accessible dismissible modal with exact message.
acceptanceCriteria: Proposal text and both button labels match exactly (including emojis).
Clicking either button opens a modal/pop-up with the exact requested message.
A visible celebratory animation plays on click (heart burst/explosion) without blocking UI interaction.
Modal can be dismissed and is accessible (keyboard focus, close button).

file_operations.description: Implement the proposal highlight with large glowing text: “Urvi Ji, will you be my Valentine? 💍❤️” and two animated buttons labeled exactly “💖 YES” and “😜 Of course YES”. Trigger a celebratory heart-burst animation on either click and open a modal message: “You just made me the happiest person alive 💕”.
Create a lightweight celebratory heart burst/explosion effect (CSS/canvas) that plays on demand and respects reduced motion; ensure it does not block interactions.

Create an accessible modal component for the proposal confirmation (focus management, close button, escape-to-close, overlay click handling). If using shadcn-ui Dialog, use the existing shadcn-ui component to provide accessibility and modal primitives; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire ProposalSection so button clicks open the modal and trigger HeartBurst, keeping UI responsive and maintaining single-page flow.

requirements.summary: Add a themed footer with the exact credit line.
acceptanceCriteria: Footer renders at the bottom of the page and shows: “Made with endless love by Mann”.
Footer styling matches the site theme and remains readable on small screens.

file_operations.description: Create a footer component that renders the exact text “Made with endless love by Mann” with theme-consistent styling and mobile-safe spacing.
Wire Footer at the bottom of the single-page layout.

requirements.summary: Implement smooth single-page navigation (section nav and/or scroll behavior), ensure mobile responsiveness and performance, and add a “Copy link” share control with feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: All sections render correctly on mobile (no horizontal scrolling, no clipped text).
A “Copy link” (or equivalent) control copies the current URL and provides user feedback.
Scroll animations are smooth and do not cause layout shift.
Initial load remains performant (images are reasonably sized; effects are efficient).

file_operations.description: Add a small single-page section navigation (anchors to section ids) that uses smooth scrolling and remains unobtrusive on mobile; avoid multi-page routing.
Implement a “Copy link” control that copies window.location.href via navigator.clipboard and shows clear success/failure feedback without heavy dependencies.
Wire SectionNav and CopyLinkButton into the layout; ensure each required section has a stable id; confirm overall responsiveness (no horizontal overflow) and keep animations/particles efficient.
Wire favicon and performance-friendly metadata: add a link tag for frontend/public/assets/generated/favicon-heart-gold.dim_256x256.png and ensure the document remains optimized for fast loading.
Add generated favicon asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/favicon-heart-gold.dim_256x256.png for the site icon (Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).
